thread:
Priya: quick bring-up notes for nectar9b (candidate for chat+summaries). ran int8, int6, and fp16 on production-like slices (mix of short chat & long summary). sharing top-line perf, quality delta, and suggested traffic rules.

Priya: perf (batch=1, seq=1024 sample):
```
int8 : tp 13.6 req/s, p50 40ms, p95 160ms, p99 330ms, cost ~ $0.030 / 1k tokens
int6 : tp 12.1 req/s, p50 46ms, p95 185ms, p99 380ms, cost ~ $0.023 / 1k tokens
fp16 : tp 9.0  req/s, p50 68ms, p95 260ms, p99 540ms, cost ~ $0.050 / 1k tokens
```

Priya: quality (GTN 8k samples, mixed intents):
- fp16 baseline ROUGE-L 0.417
- int8 ROUGE-L 0.412 (-0.5 pts, ~1.2%)
- int6 ROUGE-L 0.404 (-1.3 pts, ~3.1%)

Dan: unit econ quick calc assuming 1.5k tokens / req -> int8 ~$0.045 / req, int6 ~$0.035 / req. So moving 40% traffic to int6 saves ~ $4.0k per 100k requests.

Zoe: product check: where is regression concentrated?

Priya: mostly on long summaries and multi-turn stateful chat. single-turn Q&A almost identical.

Carlos: ops observed occasional decode truncation with int6 under heavy tail (KV-cache edge). filed ML-912 and added retry counts. Recommend fallback to int8 on error.

Dan: my recommendation: conservative split for now: chat-short -> 80% int6 / 20% int8; chat-long & summaries -> pin int8, reserve int6 for cheap tier only behind post-filter.

Priya: example routing snippet I'll push to canary:
```json
{"model":"nectar9b","routing":{"chat-short":{"int6":0.8,"int8":0.2},"summaries":{"int8":1.0}},"fallback":"int8","canary_samples":4000}
```

Zoe: GTN gating (24h smoke): ROUGE-L drop <=1.0 absolute on summary slice, p99 latency <=400ms, error rate <=0.25%. Fail -> rollback to int8.

Priya: other notes:
- quick mixed-int experiment (prefix int6, decode int8) recovered ~0.6 ROUGE pts in our bench; infra changes needed but promising.
- short quant-finetune (2k steps) estimate ~2 TPU days, expected to recover ~0.8-1.0 ROUGE pts for int6.

Carlos: infra checklist before canary: KV-cache alignment fix (PR#478), canary quota bump, shadow traffic 4h. Scheduling 2025-08-01T01:00Z.

Dan: will prepare cost/benefit slide for GTN (include expected payback period at current volume).

Priya: tagging @Dan @Zoe @Carlos  can someone own the 8k sample focused slice eval? Dan?

Dan: I can take it. ETA 36h.

infra-bot: Canary scheduled: nectar9b-int6 -> 2025-08-01T01:00Z, samples=4000, owner=Carlos. Monitoring: latency, rouge-l, errors.

Priya: ok closing. high-level: int8 remains default for quality-sensitive routes; int6 is viable for short-chat and cost tiers with guarded fallbacks and plan for quant-finetune. :thumbsup:
